facts.text: The Falcon Tuition Guarantee fixes tuition, on-campus housing, and meal plan costs for four academic years for incoming undergraduate students.

sources.title: Falcon Tuition Guarantee FAQ - Bowling Green State University
sources.quote: The Falcon Tuition Guarantee provides all undergraduate, first-time students and their families the certainty that tuition, on-campus housing and meal plans, out-of-state surcharge, special purpose fees and course and class fees will not increase over the four academic years
